verdict: Ads have been dark 19 days; pipeline and organic are holding ground.
narrative: Paid ads on Meta stopped running on August 6th, and no new leads have come in since. The 27 leads received earlier in the 28-day window — at a cost of $24.43 each — never entered the follow-up pipeline, which is being corrected now. Your Google Business Profile stayed active with 173 actions and 58 calls this period, and organic search held steady, so the floor is intact. Ads will resume once the engagement renewal is signed, which is expected by August 31st. Once that is in place, campaigns, pipeline automation, and follow-up sequences all move forward together.
